messages:
maya_k: quick follow-up after yesterday's postmortem — we need a concrete plan for recurring pager storms tied to noisy auth-service 502s. who can own remediation + timeline?
jon_h: I can own the threshold tuning + quick suppression. propose 2 business days for a hotfix to reduce noisy paging windows.
sara_p: i'll take dedupe logic and runbook updates. aim to have a runbook draft by EOD Thu.
liam_r: devon, can infra look at routing fallback that triggered flapping? seen pattern across regions.
devon_ops: noted. i'll triage logs and KV cache warming. PR for graceful fallback config by next Tue.
maya_k: action items:
- jon_h: reduce noise by adjusting 502 rate threshold & add a 2m suppression window (due +2d)
- sara_p: dedupe rule to group by user_id + endpoint fingerprint + sample aggregation 1m (draft +3d)
- devon_ops: investigate regional routing flaps + propose fallback cooldown (due +5d)
- liam_r: add metric-based alert for "auth-502-rate" with burnrate check (due +4d)
Please add links to PRs/PR numbers here when created.
alerts-bot: New alert created: auth-502-rate | severity: P3 | query id: 9876
jon_h: quick config snippet i'm planning to apply:
```
alert:
  name: auth-502-rate
  expr: sum(rate(http_responses_total{service="auth",status="502"}[5m])) by (region)
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Auth 502 error spike in {{ $labels.region }}"
```
sara_p: for dedupe i'll use this pseudo-rule: group by (user_id, route_hash) and only page if distinct_count(user_id)>10 in 5m window.
maya_k: can we also track recurrence pattern? suggest a weekly dashboard and a regression eval that counts postmortem repeats. jon, sara, devon add the dashboard widgets you need and i'll allocate 1 day this sprint.
liam_r: also adding a quick fail-closed policy: if downstream disk pressure is detected, lower page severity to P4 automatically (we'll log it).
jon_h: ack. i'll open a RFC PR for the suppression window and link it here.
sara_p: will ping ops when runbook draft is up. tagging @devon_ops for verify.
devon_ops: thanks — i'll attach log snippets and region mapping once triage complete.
maya_k: timeline recap: hotfix (jon) +2d, dedupe draft (sara) +3d, alert metric (liam) +4d, routing cooldown (devon) +5d. we'll review in next oncall sync. :thumbsup:
liam_r: adding a note: if suppression reduces visibility, we fallback to sampling alert with 1 in 20 sampling + detailed logs channel.
maya_k: perfect. closing this thread once PR links posted. thx everyone.
